passages.text: Now these were the men who came to David at Ziklag, while he was still banished from the presence of Saul son of Kish (they were among the mighty men who helped him in battle; they were archers using both the right and left hands to sling stones and shoot arrows; and they were Saul’s kinsmen from Benjamin): Ahiezer their chief and Joash, who were the sons of Shemaah the Gibeathite; Jeziel and Pelet, the sons of Azmaveth; Beracah; Jehu the Anathothite; Ishmaiah the Gibeonite, a mighty man among the Thirty and a leader over the Thirty; Jeremiah, Jahaziel, Johanan, and Jozabad the Gederathite; Eluzai, Jerimoth, Bealiah, Shemariah, and Shephatiah the Haruphite; Elkanah, Isshiah, Azarel, Joezer, and Jashobeam, who were Korahites; and Joelah and Zebadiah, the sons of Jeroham from Gedor.
passages.sermon:
David was at Ziklag.
Saul son of Kish had banished David.
Some men came to David at Ziklag.
These men were mighty warriors.
They helped David in battle.
They were skilled archers.
They could use both right and left hands to sling stones.
They could shoot arrows with the bow.
They were relatives of Saul.
They were from the tribe of Benjamin.
Ahiezer was their chief.
Joash was with him.
Ahiezer and Joash were sons of Shemaah the Gibeathite.
Jeziel and Pelet also came.
Jeziel and Pelet were sons of Azmaveth.
Beracah came.
Jehu the Anathothite came.
Ishmaiah the Gibeonite came.
Ishmaiah was a mighty man among the Thirty.
Ishmaiah was a leader over the Thirty.
Jeremiah came.
Jahaziel came.
Johanan came.
Jozabad the Gederathite came.
Eluzai came.
Jerimoth came.
Bealiah came.
Shemariah came.
Shephatiah the Haruphite came.
Elkanah came.
Isshiah came.
Azarel came.
Joezer came.
Jashobeam came.
These five were Korahites.
Joelah came.
Zebadiah came.
Joelah and Zebadiah were sons of Jeroham from Gedor.
passages.original: וְאֵ֗לֶּה הַבָּאִ֤ים אֶל־ דָּוִיד֙ לְצִ֣יקְלַ֔ג ע֣וֹד עָצ֔וּר מִפְּנֵ֖י שָׁא֣וּל בֶּן־ קִ֑ישׁ וְהֵ֙מָּה֙ בַּגִּבּוֹרִ֔ים עֹזְרֵ֖י הַמִּלְחָמָֽה׃ נֹ֣שְׁקֵי קֶ֗שֶׁת מַיְמִינִ֤ים וּמַשְׂמִאלִים֙ בָּֽאֲבָנִ֔ים וּבַחִצִּ֖ים בַּקָּ֑שֶׁת מֵאֲחֵ֥י שָׁא֖וּל מִבִּנְיָמִֽן׃ הָרֹ֨אשׁ אֲחִיעֶ֜זֶר וְיוֹאָ֗שׁ בְּנֵי֙ הַשְּׁמָעָ֣ה הַגִּבְעָתִ֔י וִיזוּאֵל וָפֶ֖לֶט בְּנֵ֣י עַזְמָ֑וֶת וּבְרָכָ֕ה וְיֵה֖וּא הָעֲנְּתֹתִֽי׃ וְיִֽשְׁמַֽעְיָ֧ה הַגִּבְעוֹנִ֛י גִּבּ֥וֹר בַּשְּׁלֹשִׁ֖ים וְעַל־ הַשְּׁלֹשִֽׁים׃ וְיִרְמְיָ֤ה וְיַחֲזִיאֵל֙ וְי֣וֹחָנָ֔ן וְיוֹזָבָ֖ד הַגְּדֵרָתִֽי׃ אֶלְעוּזַ֤י וִירִימוֹת֙ וּבְעַלְיָ֣ה וּשְׁמַרְיָ֔הוּ וּשְׁפַטְיָ֖הוּ הַחֲרִיפִי׃ אֶלְקָנָ֡ה וְ֠יִשִּׁיָּהוּ וַעֲזַרְאֵ֧ל וְיוֹעֶ֛זֶר וְיָשָׁבְעָ֖ם הַקָּרְחִֽים׃ וְיוֹעֵאלָ֧ה וּזְבַדְיָ֛ה בְּנֵ֥י יְרֹחָ֖ם מִן־ הַגְּדֽוֹר׃

passages.text: Some Gadites defected to David at his stronghold in the desert. They were mighty men of valor, trained for battle, experts with the shield and spear, whose faces were like the faces of lions and who were as swift as gazelles on the mountains: Ezer the chief, Obadiah the second in command, Eliab the third, Mishmannah the fourth, Jeremiah the fifth, Attai the sixth, Eliel the seventh, Johanan the eighth, Elzabad the ninth, Jeremiah the tenth, and Machbanai the eleventh.
passages.sermon:
Some men from the tribe of Gad joined David.
They came to David at his stronghold in the desert.
These men were mighty warriors.
They were soldiers trained for battle.
They were skilled with the shield and spear.
Their faces looked like the faces of lions.
They were as swift as gazelles on the mountains.
Ezer was the chief among them.
Obadiah was the second.
Eliab was the third.
Mishmannah was the fourth.
Jeremiah was the fifth.
Attai was the sixth.
Eliel was the seventh.
Johanan was the eighth.
Elzabad was the ninth.
Jeremiah was the tenth.
Machbanai was the eleventh.
passages.original: וּמִן־ הַגָּדִ֡י נִבְדְּל֣וּ אֶל־ דָּוִיד֩ לַמְצַ֨ד מִדְבָּ֜רָה גִּבֹּרֵ֣י הַחַ֗יִל אַנְשֵׁ֤י צָבָא֙ לַמִּלְחָמָ֔ה עֹרְכֵ֥י צִנָּ֖ה וָרֹ֑מַח וּפְנֵ֤י אַרְיֵה֙ פְּנֵיהֶ֔ם וְכִצְבָאיִ֥ם עַל־ הֶהָרִ֖ים לְמַהֵֽר׃ס עֵ֖זֶר הָרֹ֑אשׁ עֹבַדְיָה֙ הַשֵּׁנִ֔י אֱלִיאָ֖ב הַשְּׁלִשִֽׁי׃ מִשְׁמַנָּה֙ הָרְבִיעִ֔י יִרְמְיָ֖ה הַחֲמִשִֽׁי׃ עַתַּי֙ הַשִּׁשִּׁ֔י אֱלִיאֵ֖ל הַשְּׁבִעִֽי׃ יֽוֹחָנָן֙ הַשְּׁמִינִ֔י אֶלְזָבָ֖ד הַתְּשִׁיעִֽי׃ יִרְמְיָ֙הוּ֙ הָעֲשִׂירִ֔יס מַכְבַּנַּ֖י עַשְׁתֵּ֥י עָשָֽׂר׃

passages.text: These Gadites were army commanders, the least of whom was a match for a hundred, and the greatest for a thousand.
passages.sermon:
The Gadites were mighty warriors.
They served as commanders in David’s army.
Each Gadite commander was very strong.
The weakest commander could fight against one hundred men.
The strongest commander could fight against one thousand men.
passages.original: אֵ֥לֶּה מִבְּנֵי־ גָ֖ד רָאשֵׁ֣י הַצָּבָ֑א אֶחָ֤ד לְמֵאָה֙ הַקָּטָ֔ן וְהַגָּד֖וֹל לְאָֽלֶף׃

passages.text: These are the ones who crossed the Jordan in the first month when it was overflowing all its banks, and they put to flight all those in the valleys, both to the east and to the west.
passages.sermon:
Some Gadites joined David at his stronghold in the desert.
These men were mighty warriors.
They crossed the Jordan River in the first month.
At that time, the river was overflowing all its banks.
They drove out everyone in the valleys.
They put people to flight both to the east and to the west.
passages.original: אֵ֣לֶּה הֵ֗ם אֲשֶׁ֨ר עָבְר֤וּ אֶת־ הַיַּרְדֵּן֙ בַּחֹ֣דֶשׁ הָרִאשׁ֔וֹן וְה֥וּא מְמַלֵּ֖א עַל־ כָּל־ גִּדיֹתָיו וַיַּבְרִ֙יחוּ֙ אֶת־ כָּל־ הָ֣עֲמָקִ֔ים לַמִּזְרָ֖ח וְלַֽמַּעֲרָֽב׃ס

passages.text: Other Benjamites and some men from Judah also came to David in his stronghold.
passages.sermon:
Some men came from the tribe of Benjamin.
Some men came from the tribe of Judah.
They came to David.
They came to David’s stronghold.
passages.original: וַיָּבֹ֗אוּ מִן־ בְּנֵ֤י בִנְיָמִן֙ וִֽיהוּדָ֔ה עַד־ לַמְצָ֖ד לְדָוִֽיד׃

passages.text: And David went out to meet them, saying, “If you have come to me in peace to help me, my heart will be united with you; but if you have come to betray me to my enemies when my hands are free of violence, may the God of our fathers see it and judge you.”
passages.sermon:
David was the leader of the people.
David went out to meet the men who came to him.
He spoke to them directly.
He said, "If you have come in peace to help me, I will join my heart with yours."
He said, "But if you have come to betray me to my enemies, my hands are innocent."
He said, "May the God of our fathers see this and judge you."
passages.original: וַיֵּצֵ֣א דָוִיד֮ לִפְנֵיהֶם֒ וַיַּ֙עַן֙ וַיֹּ֣אמֶר לָהֶ֔ם אִם־ לְשָׁל֞וֹם בָּאתֶ֤ם אֵלַי֙ לְעָזְרֵ֔נִי יִֽהְיֶה־ לִּ֧י עֲלֵיכֶ֛ם לֵבָ֖ב לְיָ֑חַד וְאִֽם־ לְרַמּוֹתַ֣נִי לְצָרַ֗י בְּלֹ֤א חָמָס֙ בְּכַפַּ֔י יֵ֛רֶא אֱלֹהֵ֥י אֲבוֹתֵ֖ינוּ וְיוֹכַֽח׃ס

passages.text: Then the Spirit came upon Amasai, the chief of the Thirty, and he said: “We are yours, O David! We are with you, O son of Jesse! Peace, peace to you, and peace to your helpers, for your God helps you.” So David received them and made them leaders of his troops.
passages.sermon:
Amasai was the chief of the Thirty.
The Spirit of God came upon Amasai.
Amasai spoke to David.
Amasai said, “We belong to you, David.
We are with you, son of Jesse.
Peace to you.
Peace to your helpers.
Your God helps you.”
David received Amasai and his men.
David made them leaders of his troops.
passages.original: וְר֣וּחַ לָבְשָׁ֗ה אֶת־ עֲמָשַׂי֮ רֹ֣אשׁ הַשְּׁלוֹשִׁים לְךָ֤ דָוִיד֙ וְעִמְּךָ֣ בֶן־ יִשַׁ֔י שָׁל֨וֹם׀ שָׁל֜וֹם לְךָ֗ וְשָׁלוֹם֙ לְעֹ֣זְרֶ֔ךָ כִּ֥י עֲזָרְךָ֖ אֱלֹהֶ֑יךָ וַיְקַבְּלֵ֣ם דָּוִ֔יד וַֽיִּתְּנֵ֖ם בְּרָאשֵׁ֥י הַגְּדֽוּד׃פ

passages.text: Some from Manasseh defected to David when he went with the Philistines to fight against Saul. (They did not help the Philistines because the Philistine rulers consulted and sent David away, saying, “It will cost us our heads if he defects to his master Saul.”)
passages.sermon:
Some men from the tribe of Manasseh joined David.
David went with the Philistines to fight against Saul.
These men from Manasseh defected to David at that time.
They did not help the Philistines.
The Philistine rulers discussed the situation.
The rulers decided to send David away.
They said, “If David defects to his master Saul, it will cost us our heads.”
passages.original: וּמִֽמְּנַשֶּׁ֞ה נָפְל֣וּ עַל־ דָּוִ֗יד בְּבֹא֨וֹ עִם־ פְּלִשְׁתִּ֧ים עַל־ שָׁא֛וּל לַמִּלְחָמָ֖ה וְלֹ֣א עֲזָרֻ֑ם כִּ֣י בְעֵצָ֗ה שִׁלְּחֻ֜הוּ סַרְנֵ֤י פְלִשְׁתִּים֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר בְּרָאשֵׁ֕ינוּ יִפּ֖וֹל אֶל־ אֲדֹנָ֥יו שָׁאֽוּל׃

passages.text: When David went to Ziklag, these men of Manasseh defected to him: Adnah, Jozabad, Jediael, Michael, Jozabad, Elihu, and Zillethai, chiefs of thousands in Manasseh.
passages.sermon:
David was the leader chosen by God.
David traveled to Ziklag.
At that time, some men from the tribe of Manasseh joined David.
Their names were Adnah, Jozabad, Jediael, Michael, Jozabad, Elihu, and Zillethai.
These men were chiefs over thousands in Manasseh.
They left their own people and came to support David.
passages.original: בְּלֶכְתּ֣וֹ אֶל־ צִֽיקְלַ֗ג נָפְל֣וּ עָלָ֣יו׀ מִֽמְּנַשֶּׁ֡ה עַ֠דְנַח וְיוֹזָבָ֤ד וִידִֽיעֲאֵל֙ וּמִיכָאֵ֣ל וְיוֹזָבָ֔ד וֶאֱלִיה֖וּא וְצִלְּתָ֑י רָאשֵׁ֥י הָאֲלָפִ֖ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר לִמְנַשֶּֽׁה׃

passages.text: They helped David against the raiders, for they were all mighty men of valor and commanders in the army.
passages.sermon: These men helped David fight against the raiders.\r\nAll of these men were mighty men of valor.\r\nAll of these men were commanders in the army.
passages.original: וְהֵ֗מָּה עָזְר֤וּ עִם־ דָּוִיד֙ עַֽל־ הַגְּד֔וּד כִּֽי־ גִבּ֥וֹרֵי חַ֖יִל כֻּלָּ֑ם וַיִּהְי֥וּ שָׂרִ֖ים בַּצָּבָֽא׃

passages.text: For at that time men came to David day after day to help him, until he had a great army, like the army of God.
passages.sermon:
David was the leader chosen by God.
Men came to David every day.
They came to help him.
More men joined him each day.
His army grew very large.
His army became like the army of God.
passages.original: כִּ֚י לְעֶת־ י֣וֹם בְּי֔וֹם יָבֹ֥אוּ עַל־ דָּוִ֖יד לְעָזְר֑וֹ עַד־ לְמַחֲנֶ֥ה גָד֖וֹל כְּמַחֲנֵ֥ה אֱלֹהִֽים׃פ

passages.text: Now these are the numbers of men armed for battle who came to David at Hebron to turn Saul’s kingdom over to him, in accordance with the word of the LORD: From Judah: 6,800 armed troops bearing shields and spears.
passages.sermon:
David was in Hebron.
Many men came to him.
They were armed for battle.
They came to help David become king.
They came to turn Saul’s kingdom over to David.
This happened as the LORD had said.
Men from the tribe of Judah came.
There were 6,800 men from Judah.
They carried shields.
They carried spears.
They were ready for battle.
passages.original: וְ֠אֵלֶּה מִסְפְּרֵ֞י רָאשֵׁ֤י הֶֽחָלוּץ֙ לַצָּבָ֔א בָּ֥אוּ עַל־ דָּוִ֖יד חֶבְר֑וֹנָה לְהָסֵ֞ב מַלְכ֥וּת שָׁא֛וּל אֵלָ֖יו כְּפִ֥י יְהוָֽה׃ס בְּנֵ֣י יְהוּדָ֔ה נֹשְׂאֵ֥י צִנָּ֖ה וָרֹ֑מַח שֵׁ֧שֶׁת אֲלָפִ֛ים וּשְׁמוֹנֶ֥ה מֵא֖וֹת חֲלוּצֵ֥י צָבָֽא׃ס

passages.text: From Simeon: 7,100 mighty men of valor, ready for battle.
passages.sermon:
The tribe of Simeon sent men to David.
These men were mighty warriors.
They were ready for battle.
There were 7,100 of them.
passages.original: מִן־ בְּנֵ֣י שִׁמְע֗וֹן גִּבּ֤וֹרֵי חַ֙יִל֙ לַצָּבָ֔א שִׁבְעַ֥ת אֲלָפִ֖ים וּמֵאָֽה׃ס

passages.text: From Levi: 4,600, including Jehoiada, leader of the house of Aaron, with 3,700 men, and Zadok, a mighty young man of valor, with 22 commanders from his own family.
passages.sermon:
The tribe of Levi sent men to David at Hebron.
They sent 4,600 men in total.
Jehoiada was the leader of the house of Aaron.
Jehoiada brought 3,700 men with him.
Zadok was a young man.
Zadok was mighty and brave.
Zadok came with 22 commanders from his own family.
passages.original: מִן־ בְּנֵי֙ הַלֵּוִ֔י אַרְבַּ֥עַת אֲלָפִ֖ים וְשֵׁ֥שׁ מֵאֽוֹת׃ס וִיהוֹיָדָ֖ע הַנָּגִ֣יד לְאַהֲרֹ֑ן וְעִמּ֕וֹ שְׁלֹ֥שֶׁת אֲלָפִ֖ים וּשְׁבַ֥ע מֵאֽוֹת׃ס וְצָד֥וֹק נַ֖עַר גִּבּ֣וֹר חָ֑יִל וּבֵית־ אָבִ֥יו שָׂרִ֖ים עֶשְׂרִ֥ים וּשְׁנָֽיִם׃ס

passages.text: From Benjamin, the kinsmen of Saul: 3,000, most of whom had remained loyal to the house of Saul up to that time.
passages.sermon:
The tribe of Benjamin sent men.
These men were kinsmen of Saul.
They numbered 3,000.
Most of these men had remained loyal to the house of Saul until that time.
passages.original: וּמִן־ בְּנֵ֧י בִנְיָמִ֛ן אֲחֵ֥י שָׁא֖וּל שְׁלֹ֣שֶׁת אֲלָפִ֑ים וְעַד־ הֵ֙נָּה֙ מַרְבִּיתָ֔ם שֹׁמְרִ֕ים מִשְׁמֶ֖רֶת בֵּ֥ית שָׁאֽוּל׃ס

passages.text: From Ephraim: 20,800 mighty men of valor, famous among their own clans.
passages.sermon:
The tribe of Ephraim sent men.
They sent 20,800 men.
These men were mighty men of valor.
They were famous among their own clans.
passages.original: וּמִן־ בְּנֵ֣י אֶפְרַ֔יִם עֶשְׂרִ֥ים אֶ֖לֶף וּשְׁמוֹנֶ֣ה מֵא֑וֹת גִּבּ֣וֹרֵי חַ֔יִל אַנְשֵׁ֥י שֵׁמ֖וֹת לְבֵ֥ית אֲבוֹתָֽם׃ס

passages.text: From the half-tribe of Manasseh: 18,000 designated by name to come and make David king.
passages.sermon:
The half-tribe of Manasseh sent men.
They sent 18,000 men.
Leaders chose these men by name.
These men came to make David king.
passages.original: וּמֵחֲצִי֙ מַטֵּ֣ה מְנַשֶּׁ֔ה שְׁמוֹנָ֥ה עָשָׂ֖ר אָ֑לֶף אֲשֶׁ֤ר נִקְּבוּ֙ בְּשֵׁמ֔וֹת לָב֖וֹא לְהַמְלִ֥יךְ אֶת־ דָּוִֽיד׃ס

passages.text: From Issachar, men who understood the times and knew what Israel should do: 200 chiefs with all their kinsmen at their command.
passages.sermon:
The tribe of Issachar had men with special understanding.
These men understood the times.
They knew what Israel should do.
There were 200 chiefs among them.
All their kinsmen followed their command.
passages.original: וּמִבְּנֵ֣י יִשָּׂשכָ֗ר יוֹדְעֵ֤י בִינָה֙ לַֽעִתִּ֔ים לָדַ֖עַת מַה־ יַּעֲשֶׂ֣ה יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל רָאשֵׁיהֶ֣ם מָאתַ֔יִם וְכָל־ אֲחֵיהֶ֖ם עַל־ פִּיהֶֽם׃ס

passages.text: From Zebulun: 50,000 fit for service, trained for battle with all kinds of weapons of war, who with one purpose were devoted to David.
passages.sermon:
The tribe of Zebulun sent men to David.
These men were fit for military service.
There were 50,000 men from Zebulun.
They were trained for battle.
They could use all kinds of weapons of war.
They were united in purpose.
They were fully devoted to David.
passages.original: מִזְּבֻל֞וּן יוֹצְאֵ֣י צָבָ֗א עֹרְכֵ֧י מִלְחָמָ֛ה בְּכָל־ כְּלֵ֥י מִלְחָמָ֖ה חֲמִשִּׁ֣ים אָ֑לֶף וְלַעֲדֹ֖ר בְּלֹא־ לֵ֥ב וָלֵֽב׃ס

passages.text: From Naphtali: 1,000 commanders, accompanied by 37,000 men with shield and spear.
passages.sermon:
Naphtali was one of the tribes of Israel.
Naphtali sent 1,000 commanders.
These commanders did not come alone.
They brought 37,000 men with them.
These men carried shields.
These men also carried spears.
passages.original: וּמִנַּפְתָּלִ֖י שָׂרִ֣ים אָ֑לֶף וְעִמָּהֶם֙ בְּצִנָּ֣ה וַחֲנִ֔ית שְׁלֹשִׁ֥ים וְשִׁבְעָ֖ה אָֽלֶף׃ס

passages.text: From Dan: 28,600 prepared for battle.
passages.sermon: Men from the tribe of Dan came.\r\nThey prepared for battle.\r\nThere were 28,600 men from Dan.
passages.original: וּמִן־ הַדָּנִי֙ עֹרְכֵ֣י מִלְחָמָ֔ה עֶשְׂרִֽים־ וּשְׁמוֹנָ֥ה אֶ֖לֶף וְשֵׁ֥שׁ מֵאֽוֹת׃ס

passages.text: From Asher: 40,000 fit for service, prepared for battle.
passages.sermon:
The tribe of Asher sent men for battle.
40,000 men from Asher were ready for war.
These men were fit for service.
They prepared themselves for battle.
passages.original: וּמֵאָשֵׁ֗ר יוֹצְאֵ֥י צָבָ֛א לַעֲרֹ֥ךְ מִלְחָמָ֖ה אַרְבָּעִ֥ים אָֽלֶף׃ס

passages.text: And from east of the Jordan, from Reuben, Gad, and the half-tribe of Manasseh there: 120,000 armed with every kind of weapon of war.
passages.sermon:
Reuben, Gad, and the half-tribe of Manasseh lived east of the Jordan River.
These three groups sent men for battle.
They sent 120,000 men.
Each man carried every kind of weapon of war.
passages.original: וּמֵעֵ֣בֶר לַ֠יַּרְדֵּן מִן־ הָראוּבֵנִ֨י וְהַגָּדִ֜י וַחֲצִ֣י׀ שֵׁ֣בֶט מְנַשֶּׁ֗ה בְּכֹל֙ כְּלֵי֙ צְבָ֣א מִלְחָמָ֔ה מֵאָ֥ה וְעֶשְׂרִ֖ים אָֽלֶף׃

passages.text: All these men of war, arrayed for battle, came to Hebron fully determined to make David king over all Israel. And all the rest of the Israelites were of one mind to make David king.
passages.sermon:
These men were warriors.
They were ready for battle.
They came to Hebron.
They wanted to make David king over all Israel.
They were fully determined.
All the rest of the Israelites agreed.
They were united in purpose.
They also wanted to make David king.
passages.original: כָּל־ אֵ֜לֶּה אַנְשֵׁ֣י מִלְחָמָה֮ עֹדְרֵ֣י מַעֲרָכָה֒ בְּלֵבָ֤ב שָׁלֵם֙ בָּ֣אוּ חֶבְר֔וֹנָה לְהַמְלִ֥יךְ אֶת־ דָּוִ֖יד עַל־ כָּל־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וְ֠גַם כָּל־ שֵׁרִ֧ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֛ל לֵ֥ב אֶחָ֖ד לְהַמְלִ֥יךְ אֶת־ דָּוִֽיד׃

passages.text: They spent three days there eating and drinking with David, for their relatives had provided for them.
passages.sermon:
David was in Hebron.
The men of war stayed with David.
They stayed for three days.
They ate there.
They drank there.
Their relatives gave them food and drink.
passages.original: וַיִּהְיוּ־ שָׁ֤ם עִם־ דָּוִיד֙ יָמִ֣ים שְׁלוֹשָׁ֔ה אֹכְלִ֖ים וְשׁוֹתִ֑ים כִּֽי־ הֵכִ֥ינוּ לָהֶ֖ם אֲחֵיהֶֽם׃

passages.text: And their neighbors from as far away as Issachar, Zebulun, and Naphtali came bringing food on donkeys, camels, mules, and oxen—abundant supplies of flour, fig cakes and raisin cakes, wine and oil, oxen and sheep. Indeed, there was joy in Israel.
passages.sermon:
The people of Israel felt great joy.
Neighbors came from far away.
Some came from Issachar.
Some came from Zebulun.
Some came from Naphtali.
These neighbors brought food.
They carried food on donkeys.
They carried food on camels.
They carried food on mules.
They carried food on oxen.
They brought much flour.
They brought fig cakes.
They brought raisin cakes.
They brought wine.
They brought oil.
They brought many oxen.
They brought many sheep.
passages.original: וְגַ֣ם הַקְּרֽוֹבִים־ אֲ֠לֵיהֶם עַד־ יִשָׂשכָ֨ר וּזְבֻל֜וּן וְנַפְתָּלִ֗י מְבִיאִ֣ים לֶ֡חֶם בַּחֲמוֹרִ֣ים וּבַגְּמַלִּ֣ים וּבַפְּרָדִ֣ים׀ וּֽבַבָּקָ֡ר מַאֲכָ֡ל קֶ֠מַח דְּבֵלִ֨ים וְצִמּוּקִ֧ים וְיַֽיִן־ וְשֶׁ֛מֶן וּבָקָ֥ר וְצֹ֖אן לָרֹ֑ב כִּ֥י שִׂמְחָ֖ה בְּיִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃פ
